const data = $input.first().json;
const dayIndex = data.dayIndex;
const galleryTotal = data.galleryTotal;
const artistName = data.artistName;
const usedPractices = data.usedPractices;
const usedMusic = data.usedMusic;
const usedPoems = data.usedPoems;

const prompt = `You are generating ONE edition of "Daily Sublime" (Gallery ${dayIndex} of ${galleryTotal}) for ${artistName} only. THIS MUST BE WORTH €19.

IMPORTANT: Do NOT include any image URLs. URLs will be fetched from Wikimedia API separately. Focus ONLY on written content and EXACT painting titles.

The reader must feel: engaged and curious, quietly smarter, confident in their intelligence, motivated to do a 2 to 7 minute meditative practice today.

THREE GOALS:
1. ART FAMILIARITY - Show art, TRUE sticky story, memorable association
2. ART APPRECIATION - Reveal style/technique, why_it_matters, five notice bullets
3. LIFE TRANSFER - Music, poem, meditative practice

MOST FAMOUS WORKS: Prioritize the painter's 5 most famous, widely recognized works for hero, art2, style_art, mini1, mini2. Use EXACT official painting titles as they appear on Wikimedia Commons.

STYLE: Authored, sophisticated, accessible. No clichés. No em dashes. No AI signposting words.

PRACTICE: 2-7 minutes, meditative, derived from painter's technique, applies to real life. At least ONE notice_bullet must include a micro experiment.

POEM: MANDATORY. 1-2 lines only. Different from: ${usedPoems || 'None'}

MUSIC: Different from: ${usedMusic || 'None'}

DEDUPLICATION - Practice must be different from: ${usedPractices || 'None'}

OUTPUT: Return ONLY a JSON object with these fields:
{
  "exhibition_title": "3-6 words",
  "hook_text": "40-90 words",
  "why_it_matters": "140-240 words",
  "notice_bullet_1": "18-45 words about hero",
  "notice_bullet_2": "18-45 words about art2",
  "notice_bullet_3": "18-45 words about style_art",
  "notice_bullet_4": "18-45 words about mini1",
  "notice_bullet_5": "18-45 words about mini2 with micro experiment",
  "practice": "90-160 words",
  "sticky_story": "100-180 words TRUE story",
  "sticky_story_source_url": "URL",
  "cultural_music": "Track - Artist (MUSIC OF THE DAY:) reason",
  "philosophy": "90-170 words",
  "poem_line_1": "first line",
  "poem_line_2": "second line or empty",
  "poem_author": "poet name",
  "poem_work": "poem title",
  "poem_source_url": "URL",
  "hero_title": "EXACT Wikimedia Commons title",
  "hero_year": "year",
  "hero_alt": "one sentence",
  "art2_title": "EXACT title",
  "art2_year": "year",
  "art2_alt": "description",
  "style_art_title": "EXACT title",
  "style_art_year": "year",
  "style_art_alt": "description",
  "mini1_title": "EXACT title",
  "mini1_year": "year",
  "mini1_alt": "description",
  "mini2_title": "EXACT title",
  "mini2_year": "year",
  "mini2_alt": "description"
}

Return ONLY the JSON.`;

return { prompt, dayIndex, galleryTotal, artistName };
